column1: # OnConflict{UpdateAll} upsert of a whole security-state row. Each row says why the site
# is acceptable, or that it is not (UNSAFE-OPEN #issue) and stays listed only so main
# stays green until the fix lands.
# Columns: file <TAB> function <TAB> model <TAB> reason <TAB> expires <TAB> added_by <TAB> reviewed_by
#   SAFE-CAS     a conditional write (WHERE on the state column) and no narrower writer of
#                any other column of that table exists, so nothing can be reverted.
#   RESIDUAL     a stale revert is possible, of the columns named, none of which gates
#   UNSAFE-OPEN  a real race; the issue tracks the fix. Not "accepted": remove the row
#   pending: #N  an open PR fixes this site; the row expires (expires column) and
#   arrives with #N  pre-registered for a site an open PR creates or renames; may match
# reviewed_by must be non-empty and differ from added_by
# CALLER rows (model column "calls:<LocalStorage method>") belong to
# one row per (file, enclosing function, writer method it calls). The caller is the
# stale writer when it hands the primitive a struct it read earlier. Classification of a
# caller row is the callee row's class plus whether THIS caller's read/write is gated.
# Rows marked "[carried #2725]" restate the independently reviewed verdict of the same
# caller in #2725's ledger (reviewed_by C-GUARD3-EXEMPT-REVIEW); rows marked
# "[callee verdict]" had no #2725 row (or the function was renamed/split since) and restate
# the reviewed verdict of the callee row above, with added_by SMALL-FIX-1: they still need

column4: SAFE-CAS: conditional on state='open' (WHERE id AND state); the only transition is open->closed by CloseAccessReviewCampaign, a losing racer matches 0 rows, and no other writer changes any column of an open campaign (purge deletes only closed ones).

SAFE-CAS: conditional on decision='pending' and an open campaign; on main no other writer changes an item row, and the snapshot columns are immutable. (Open PR #2678 adds RevertAccessReviewItemClaim, column-scoped and conditional on decision+decided_by.)

RESIDUAL: one caller (break_glass.go revert-after-grant-failure) on a row it created in the same operation; it always writes the terminal state=revoked, so state cannot regress. A racing RevokeBreakGlassActivation can have its revoked_by attribution overwritten with 0 (audit attribution only).

UNSAFE-OPEN #2691 (dup #2698): ClassifyDynamicSecretConfig's stale Save writes disabled=false over a concurrent DeleteProject/kill-switch disable (#369). The other caller on main, CreateDynamicSecretConfig's DSN persist, is #2651 (fix: open PR #2675).

UNSAFE-OPEN #2698: RenewLease's stale Save can write status=active with a later expires_at over a concurrent RevokeLease's revoke_failed (target drop failed, credential still live); the sweep then waits for the extended expiry, and the revoke_failed signal is lost. A successful revoke can also be flipped back to active (bookkeeping; holds a MaxActiveLeases slot until the sweep). Renew is a no-op for MySQL/Mongo/Redis, so it does not fail first there.
SAFE-CAS: conditional on state='pending'; no other writer changes a pending request's columns (purge removes only resolved rows).
SAFE-CAS: conditional on state='pending'; every invitation writer goes through this transition, no column-narrower writer exists.
RESIDUAL: one caller (LiftLegalHold); released only ever goes false->true and rows are never deleted, so a racing second lift only overwrites released_by/release_reason (and audits twice).

SAFE-CAS: conditional on state; every membership writer goes through this transition and changes only state-related columns. (The role-grant side effect of a racing activate/revoke is #2657/#2659, not a column revert.)
UNSAFE-OPEN #2692: BeginMFAEnrollment's late OnConflict{UpdateAll} upsert replaces an already-activated secret after a concurrent ActivateMFA.
